notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update! NPC Fixes, Bug Squashing & Achievement Clarification
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’ve just released a new update for the [b]Videoclub Simulator[/b] demo, focused on fixing the most critical bugs reported by the community. Thanks so much for your feedback — it helped us a lot![/p][p][/p][h3]✅ Key Fixes:[/h3][p]🧍‍♂️ [b]Improved NPC behavior[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs [b]no longer get stuck[/b] in the checkout queue.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs [b]no longer disappear randomly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]customers stopped entering[/b] the store entirely.[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ We’ve also resolved [b]several minor NPC-related bugs[/b] to improve overall stability.[/p][p]🏆 [b]Achievements tested[/b]
All demo achievements have been tested and [b]can be unlocked[/b]. If you're aiming for 100% completion, go for it![/p][p][/p][h3]ℹ️ Important note about the demo ending:[/h3][p]The demo ends when you reach [b]level 8[/b], which also [b]resets your save[/b].
📌 So if you’re aiming for the [b]“Tutorial Completed”[/b] achievement, make sure to [b]finish all tutorial-related missions before hitting level 8[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing! If you find anything else or have feedback, feel free to post it here or on our social channels — we’re always listening.[/p][p][/p][p]— The Willstar Games Team[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Major Update: Save System Enabled & NPCs Unblocked! 🚀
notes.content:
[p]Hello movie lovers![/p][p]We’ve just launched a [b]brand new build[/b] of the [b]Videoclub Simulator[/b] demo — and it comes with some of the most requested features and fixes from the community.[/p][p][/p][h3]💾 [b]Save Your Progress – Finally![/b][/h3][p]You asked for it, and it's here:
You can now [b]save your game and continue later[/b] without losing your progress, missions, or achievements.
[/p][h3]🧍‍♂️ [b]No More Stuck or Missing NPCs[/b][/h3][p]A major issue that caused [b]NPCs to stop arriving[/b] or get stuck around doors and shelves has been [b]completely resolved[/b].
In addition, we’ve upgraded their behavior and logic to feel more natural and dynamic.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 More Improvements:[/h3][p]🖥️ [b]New in-game PC design[/b]
Inspired by Windows XP — a nostalgic, yet functional upgrade to your store computer.[/p][p]🎨 [b]Revamped User Interface[/b]
Cleaner, more modern and easier to navigate. A full redesign of the UI to improve your management experience.[/p][p]🎯 [b]You Can Now Finish the Demo[/b]
All internal missions and achievements are now fully functional. Try to complete them all![/p][p]🗨️ [b]Improved Customer Comments[/b]
NPCs now leave smarter, more relevant feedback based on your store's condition.[/p][p]🌆 [b]Enhanced environment & minor bug fixes[/b]
We’ve also polished visuals, fixed various glitches, and improved overall game performance.[/p][p][/p][p]📥 [b]Update now and let us know what you think![/b]
This is a big step toward Early Access — and your feedback is more valuable than ever.
Join the discussion on Steam or our Discord server.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey!
— [i]The Willstar Games Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🚧 Upcoming Update: New Save System, Bug Fixes & UI Improvements 🎮
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

First off, thank you so much for the amazing support and feedback since the launch of the Videoclub Simulator demo. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to improve the overall experience based on your input.

🛠️ In the upcoming build, which will be available very soon, you'll find:

✅ Major fixes to bot (NPC) behavior: we’ve resolved several issues that were causing strange or stuck behaviors.

💾 Brand new save system: this highly requested feature is now here! You’ll be able to save your progress and continue your game. This was not available in the original demo.

🐞 Fixes for critical bugs: especially those that were preventing players from completing the demo.

🧼 UI improvements: small but important visual updates to make the game feel smoother and more polished.

✨ This update is all about ensuring a better, more stable experience so everyone can enjoy the demo from start to finish without interruptions.

📅 Stay tuned — the new build is coming very soon!

Thanks again for being part of the Videoclub Simulator journey. If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now’s a great time to jump in 😉

— The Willstar Games Team

notes.title: New Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to share our latest update, which brings several improvements and bug fixes to Videoclub Simulator. We've been listening to your feedback, and this update aims to enhance your experience.

🚀 Improvements:
[list]
[*] Enhanced LOD for interior doors, providing better visual quality.

[*] Added missing translations in some notifications to improve localization.

[*] Implemented a new notification when an employee resigns due to lack of payment.

[*] Reduced trash production, making the store easier to keep clean.

[*] Adjusted lighting for some lamps to create a more balanced ambiance.

[*] Added more options to the configuration menu for better customization.
[/list]

🐛 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved camera movement for a smoother experience.

[*] Fixed various bugs to improve overall gameplay stability.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Let us know what you think of the new changes, and as always, happy managing!

– The Willstar Games Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Update: Improvements to Store, Lighting, and Customer Feedback!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 👋

We’ve just released a new update for the Videoclub Simulator Demo with several improvements based on your feedback. Here's what's new:

🧹 Cleanliness now matters!

Trash no longer reduces your store's popularity directly.

However, customers will now complain if the store is dirty, which can affect the experience they gain during their visit.

💬 New customer comments

Customers will now leave comments about the state of your store. Make sure to keep it clean and welcoming!

🛒 Store updates and price adjustments

We've made updates to the in-game store, including some adjustments to item prices to improve balance.

💡 General lighting improvements

We’ve reworked the lighting across the game to make the experience brighter and more comfortable to play.

We are continuing to work hard to improve the demo experience based on your feedback.
Thanks so much for playing and supporting Videoclub Simulator! 🙌

Please keep sending us your feedback! It helps us a lot! 🎮

– Willstar Games Team

notes.title: Update – Auto Language Detection + Smarter Settings 🌍
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve rolled out an update that improves the experience right from launch:

🆕 What’s new?
[list]
[*] The game now automatically detects your Steam language.
If it’s English or Spanish, it will apply accordingly.
For other languages, the game will default to English. 🌐
[*] We also improved the settings menu — changes now apply automatically, with no need to press “Apply”. ⚙️
[/list]

This should make it easier for everyone to jump in and start playing without confusion.
Thanks again for all your support and feedback during the demo!
